comment: Per-student prefix policy for FMI OS Materials storage (Task 1.7, Requirements 1.1, 1.5, 7.3). Each authenticated student may only access objects under private/${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub}/ in the S3 bucket. The variable ${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub} is the IAM policy condition key that resolves at request time to the signed-in student's Cognito Identity ID, so no student can read or write another student's prefix. This file documents the intended IAM scoping; the canonical, enforced policy is expressed in override.ts, which the Amplify CLI applies to the generated S3 CloudFormation stack on `amplify push`.
